jei.simulacra.neural_node: Turns rotation into compute. The faster it spins the more Cognition Units it makes. Touching nodes form one Cognition Array.
jei.simulacra.mainframe_controller: Pools every Neural Node it can reach into one budget. One controller per array.
jei.simulacra.data_cable: Carries compute to machines that are not next to the controller. Stores nothing, costs nothing.
jei.simulacra.simulation_chamber: Trains a Data Matrix, then spends compute printing Predictions onto Imprint Blanks. Spawns no mobs.
jei.simulacra.loot_fabricator: Turns Predictions into drops. Runs on rotation, not compute. Left alone it rolls the loot table. Pick a drop and it makes only that, priced by rarity.
jei.simulacra.blank_data_matrix: Hold one in your off hand and kill a mob to bind it. More kills feed it data until a Simulation Chamber can take over.
jei.simulacra.prediction: One roll of a mob's drops. Use it in a Loot Fabricator.
jei.simulacra.imprint_blank: What a Simulation Chamber prints onto. Finer grades yield more Predictions, and only Pristine can hold a boss.
jei.simulacra.corrupted_imprint: A failed print. Low-grade models botch some jobs. Crush one to recover material.
jei.simulacra.resonant_catalyst: Sometimes left behind by a boss simulation. The renewable route to Pristine Imprint Blanks.

simulacra.ponder.loot_fabricator.text_2: Feed it Predictions. A funnel in, a funnel out.
simulacra.ponder.loot_fabricator.text_3: Left alone it rolls the loot table, one Prediction per roll
